title: 영산포 남안 2차 추가 지붕 관찰

sourceExtent.usage: Local visual reference only; do not redistribute source imagery or tiles.

imageryCaptureDate: unknown; do not describe as a current survey
method: Manually inspected original image and original-resolution crops. Visible roof corners were recorded against the 1300x1000 pixel convention and converted using the exact Web Mercator tile extent. Existing traced roofs and OSM buildings were compared; overlapping or road-close candidates were excluded.
usage: Approximate numerical context massing only. These are visible roof planes, not surveyed ground footprints or cadastral boundaries. Source imagery and local verification overlays must not be redistributed. OSM road/building alignment and authored landmarks take precedence.
estimates: Every height, roof colour, wall colour and inferred massing is approximate. A satellite roof alone does not identify facade openings, exact floor count, ownership or present-day condition.
